bullets: On Friday 16 October, Dubai recorded 363 sales worth AED 1.1bn, which is 23.1% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 55.1% of Friday sales, compared to 66.7% over the last 7 days.
The median price was AED 1,753 per sq ft, up 6.3% against the 30-day average and down 0.1% year-on-year.
Weekly sales averaged 548 per day this week, down 35.6% compared to the same week last year.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1BR apartment median rent was AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.

bullets: On Monday 19 October, DLD recorded 702 sales worth AED 1.7bn, down 3.1% compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan share reached 69.2%, compared to a 7-day average of 65.2%.
The median price was AED 1,720 per sq ft, up 4.3% over the last 30 days and up 1.0% compared to last year.
Over the last 7 days, Dubai South (DWC) led sales with 290 transactions, followed by JVC with 188 and Majan with 126.
In September new rental contracts, a JVC 1-bedroom apartment had a median rent of AED 69,000 a year, up 3.2% on the month.
